decision.meaning: Stop this fixed all-pair weight1 auxiliary hypothesis. Local saved-margin tension is not proof of causal objective conflict or an AdamW trajectory. A different mechanism requires its own prospective plan.

independent_audit_limits: Only explicit TRAIN roles are read; no validation, TEST, stress or point0 payload access.
Known TRAIN in-sample geometry, decoder interventions and local unit plain-gradient directions are diagnostic; no generalization or observed optimizer update.
Saved CPU loss/support/geometry/maps/logits/predictions and gradient-vector arithmetic are independently replayed; CUDA encoder/decoder and autodiff are not rerun.

CUDA gradient and exact model-state preservation rely on hash-bound producer/admission source and its real CUDA tests; standard-library inspection does not independently decode ordinary CUDA checkpoint model/optimizer storage.

Actual row sampler and context erasure/repair streams are independently replayed. Original std::shuffle query draws are checked structurally and paired across versions, with exact generation tied to source/admission rather than a second libstdc++ implementation.
The auxiliary is normalized residual-difference reweighting, not new labels, a phase-invariant lag objective or proof of information loss.

Full-observation geometry was generated by CUDA, while cached native TRAIN exports and cached-head predictions were generated by CPU. Their discrepancy is descriptive only: the card declared no cross-device equality or bound. Exact CPU encoder-export parity remains producer/admission-source-bound; archived CPU head equations and original same-CUDA query arrays retain their checks. Geometry arithmetic and margins are independently replayed from saved CUDA geometry values, never substituted CPU values. The frozen same-CUDA graph-vs-frozen absolute1e-6 gate is unchanged.
